summary: Completed 5 of 11 plan phases with all work additive, sorry-free, and lake-build-green (full project). Critically, Phase 5 -- the plan's explicit go/no-go gate for the whole DP-2 route -- PASSED: the standalone mint-time snapshot-free residue lemma (intFImp_mint_residue) was proved exactly as the research report's section 4.2 predicted, de-risking the remainder of the route. Phase 4 (strict label bound, threaded across a large ten-case induction) was deferred (not blocking Phase 5 per the plan's own wave table) and is next in queue, followed by Phases 6-11 (IWorldHist definition, mint/non-mint arm preservation, pigeonhole and path-injection size bounds, and final sorry retirement).
decisions_made: Phase 1's one-hop extension lemma was specialized from the plan's literal fixed-edges statement to the append form (edges ++ [(c,p)]), since the fixed-edges form has a provable one-unit fuel deficit (isAccessible always uses fuel exactly edges.length, so composing one more hop from an already-fixed-fuel fact cannot be recovered by growing fuel alone). The append form is fuel-exact and matches the mint arm's real edges growth.

Phase 5 was executed before Phase 4: both are Wave 2 in the plan's dependency table (blocked only by Phases 1-3, mutually independent), and Phase 5 is the highest-risk/highest-value checkpoint to de-risk before committing to Phase 4's large induction-threading work.

Discovered and recorded (in the plan's Phase 1 section and the summary) that ancestor-accessibility needed for Phase 5/7's hacc input cannot be derived post-hoc from a fixed edges snapshot by induction on the ancestor chain -- it must be threaded incrementally, growing by exactly one hop per mint via isAccessible_append_mono + isAccessible_one_hop_ext. This is a design input Phase 6's IWorldHist definition must incorporate.
dead_ends: The literal Phase 1 statement '(c,p) in edges -> isAccessible edges x p -> isAccessible edges x c' (fixed edges, no append) is not provable in general: isAccessible edges x y always uses fuel exactly edges.length for every pair, so any one-hop composition costs one unit of fuel that a fixed snapshot cannot supply. Do not re-attempt this literal form; use the append-specialized form or thread accessibility incrementally instead.
